subject: [RFC PATCH v2 12/18] mm/filemap: set PG_rcu_free on the folios that reads keep coming back to

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new flag, PG_rcu_free, which allows the kernel to delay freeing memory associated with a folio that is frequently accessed by readers. The flag is set in filemap_read() when a folio is found to be hot based on LRU records or previous read access patterns. This approach aims to balance the trade-off between delaying free of streaming reads and truncating files, while also avoiding unnecessary delays for cold data. The patch includes changes to various kernel files to support this new flag and provide statistics on its usage.
